coaching.headline: Even in the fights, strangled between them: eight deaths alone outside any fight, and an objective sheet of 10-31.
coaching.team: The set-piece fights were close to even — two won (including a 5-1 at their inhibitor at 31.2), two lost, two even — but the game bled out between them. Eight of our deaths came with no fight around them (they gave up two), and the cost sheet itemizes it: Renna's 15.0 catch preceded Mini Prime at 15.6, the 19.3 catch cost an outer tower the same minute, and the 25.1 catch preceded the inhibitor (25.8) and Primal Fangtooth (26.3). They finished 31 objectives to our 10 and 11 towers to our 3, with 87208 objective damage to our 37211. The comp made it harder — our damage was 4/5 magical (one magic-resist item blunts most of it) and the film flags our jungler with no armor into a 32k-damage Sparrow. The final fight was the game in miniature: 2-3 at our Primal Fangtooth at 33.2 with the winning jungler absent, and the core fell at 34.3 even though we took the Primal in the same window.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Pickoffs, not teamfights: eight solo deaths against their two, three of them (Renna at 15.0, 19.3, 25.1) directly preceding Mini Prime, an outer tower and the inhibitor. We won the last big 5v5 5-1 at 31.2 — the map was already gone by then.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Mr_Meat31 did the support work in a lane that read theirs all game — 12 wards and 11896 healing on Phase. The two deaths that cost: 23.6, with their inner tower following at 24.8, and 34.2, the last body before the core at 34.3. Into a Riktor carrying a pull, a silence and a suppress, the healer's spot is behind the frontline where that chain cannot reach.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 won the jungle all game and did real map work — 13716 objective damage, 12 wards — but the macro read names Wukong twice as the ahead-and-absent player: the 20.5 Fangtooth fight was lost 0-3 and the final 33.2 fight at our Primal started without the winning jungler. A jungle lead only counts when it arrives; those two fights were where it was owed.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster was the best player in the film: 7/3/4 on GRIM.exe, 40771 hero damage, 16621 to objectives, in a lane won all game. The one costly beat was the 33.5 death after the lost Primal fight — the last domino before the core at 34.3. Nothing to coach here except the team around this performance.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim's five solo catches were the spine of the loss — 5.2 (Boris), 9.5 (Belica), 15.0 (Zarus), 19.3 (Sparrow), 25.1 (Boris) — and three carried direct price tags: Mini Prime at 15.6, the outer tower at 19.3, the inhibitor at 25.8. The hero work was fine (5 kills on the Renna core); in a mid that read theirs late, the fix is the map habit — walk nothing alone past the river, with Boris twice the one waiting.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs was a wall on Steel — 89049 mitigated — and anchored the 31.2 fight we won 5-1 at their inhibitor. Two notes: the 11.5 solo catch by Boris (and the 14.2 death that preceded their Mini Prime and an outer tower), and the 20.5 Fangtooth fight where the macro read flags Steel as alive and never joining — a frontline's absence is the difference between 0-3 and a real fight.

threats: Chain-CC risk (4 hard-CC abilities, ~3.0s of lockdown): Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Riktor. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 magical — predictable; one magic-resist item answers most of it. Mix in a physical threat.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Windsurge engage → Cyclebreaker damage-reduction spin → clones from 84000 Hairs
ourKits.winCondition: stance-dance for damage or tankiness and overwhelm with clones
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights alongside his clones
ourKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; CC him during the damage-reduction window

ourKits.combo: Energy Shield block → Displacement Blast → Assault Mode → GTFO lockon ult
ourKits.winCondition: out-trade with Pulsefire and the spell-shield, finish with GTFO
ourKits.playWith: peel so he can free-cast in Assault Mode
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Energy Shield, then commit; dodge GTFO's slow channel

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
enemyKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
enemyKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
enemyKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,199 hero damage a minute, more than 78% of GRIM.exe carry players this patch (37% of the team's). The damage came from Lightning Hawk, Scattershot, Tainted Rounds.
GRIM.exe dealt 40,771 hero damage, 37% of their team's, with +277 physical power from items.
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.

Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Xyris (Eternal): Deal 3% bonus damage, increased by 0.4% per 10 units killed, up to 400 units.
Iron Will (Eternal minor): Restore Health equal to 3% of Basic Attack damage dealt, increased to 6% for Critical Strikes.

Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Scattershot, Tainted Rounds, Iron Will.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Terminus, Pacifier.
The Eternal was part of it: Xyris (Iron Will + Bone Collector) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 3 of the 4 players GRIM.exe killed built physical armor (Boris, Riktor, Zarus). Anti-heal on Riktor, Sparrow. We killed GRIM.exe 3 times.
Copy it? Xyris (Iron Will + Bone Collector): 54.8% in 146 GRIM.exe carry games, above the hero's 47.2%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

loadout.name: Alpha's Court

loadout.name: Ferocity
loadout.text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.
loadout.plain: Attack speed that keeps climbing the longer you stay in hero combat. Rewards long brawls where Gladiator stays maxed.

loadout.name: Judgement
loadout.text: Thunder Cleaver:  Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.
loadout.plain: Damages everyone around you and heals you for each hero hit. Use it in melee range after Evade or Coliseum lands you on the enemy.

lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Died 2 times in 34 minutes, fewer deaths than about 84% of Zarus offlane players this patch. The build added health and armor and healing off damage.
Coliseum at rank 3: 120s base, about 104.3s by the end (13% shorter) from 15 ability haste: Mutilator 15.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Zarus dealt 28,226 hero damage, 27% of their team's, with +132 physical power from items.
Mutilator (item): On Successsful Basic Attacks: Deal 1% of their Max Health as Damage.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Rapture (item): While within 475u of an Enemy Unit: Your Basic Attacks deal 20 (+2.5%)(+15%) Damage On-Hit to them.
Fire Blossom (item): Burn nearby Enemy Units: Deals 15 (+1%) Damage each second.Firestorm - When Heatwave damages a Target: Deals 5% more damage each second, up to 40%.
Judgement (crest): Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.

Loadout minor Alpha's Court: Extra damage when no ally is near you. Fits Zarus dueling one target in Coliseum or a side lane, not grouped fights. (game text: Deal 6% bonus damage when no allied hero is within 800 units.) Field: 46.6% in 943 games, 80% of picks, below the hero-role's 49.1%.

Loadout minor Ferocity: Attack speed that keeps climbing the longer you stay in hero combat. Rewards long brawls where Gladiator stays maxed. (game text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.) Field: 47.6% in 1092 games, 93% of picks, below the hero-role's 49.1%.

Loadout crest Judgement: Damages everyone around you and heals you for each hero hit. Use it in melee range after Evade or Coliseum lands you on the enemy. (game text: Thunder Cleaver:  Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.) Field: 50.1% in 1392 games, 59% of picks, above the hero-role's 49.1%.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 5 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, Sky Splitter, Rapture, Salvation, Judgement.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, Sky Splitter, Rapture, Thraex.
Stack (Damage that scales with our health): 2 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, Sky Splitter. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on our side fed them.
The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Alpha's Court + Ferocity) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.

Countered? 2 of the 3 players Zarus killed built physical armor (Steel, Phase). Anti-heal on GRIM.exe, Steel. Health items on Steel, Renna raised the %-health damage they took. We killed Zarus 2 times.
Copy it? Thraex (Alpha's Court + Ferocity): 46.9% in 883 Zarus offlane games, below the hero's 49.1%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
